sentences.en: At a glance, he knew that the child was hungry.
sentences.zh: 一眼望去，他就知道孩子饿了。

sentences.en: I could tell at a glance that something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我一看就知道出问题了。

sentences.en: The man glanced at the news program and was shocked.
sentences.zh: 那人瞥了一眼新闻节目，感到震惊。
